scope: Single observed development view; within-state shadow scores are not executed trajectories or physical counterfactuals.

per_class_interpretation.shelves: original V10 class2 open multilayer structural prior
per_class_interpretation.bookcase: original V10 class2 open multilayer structural prior
per_class_interpretation.closed equipment cabinet: original V10 class3 prior from predicted closed equipment cabinet category
per_class_interpretation.cabinet: explicit real-scene extension: assume closed enclosure structural prior (V10 slot3); source category remains cabinet; not recognition of a closed equipment cabinet or measurement of hidden structure
per_class_interpretation.table: no V10 structural prior; retain original prompt namespace
per_class_interpretation.chair: no V10 structural prior; retain original prompt namespace
per_class_interpretation.display counter: explicit real-scene extension: assume closed enclosure structural prior (V10 slot3); source category remains display counter; not recognition of a closed equipment cabinet or measurement of hidden structure
per_class_interpretation.floor: no V10 structural prior; retain original prompt namespace
per_class_interpretation.wall: no V10 structural prior; retain original prompt namespace

receipt.class_semantics: uncalibrated prompt predictions; closed state and class accuracy not independently validated

model_manifest.embedding_generation: TorchScript MobileCLIP encode_text + YOLOE head.get_tpe; no model weights changed

receipt.overlap_assignment: highest detector confidence owns each measured pixel including non-V10 classes
